messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick question from AH follow-up: can we do prepaid partner credits for pilots, or does finance prefer milestone billing?
Aisha (CFO): Prefer milestone-based. Prepayments ok only with legal-approved refund clause and exec approval for > $20k.
Leo (Eng): If we prepay, does that count against current quarter burn or get capitalized?
Priya K (FP&A): Prepayments are expensed when consumed; however for runway calc we treat the cash outflow in the payment month. Flag any > $10k so FP&A can model runway impact.
Olivia (Finance Ops): Practical: open a procurement ticket, attach partner terms, and mark PREPAY in the subject. Finance Ops will route to Legal and FP&A concurrently to speed it up.
Maya (Partnerships): Partner is requesting a 30% upfront to secure dev resources. Can we push to 10%?
Aisha (CFO): Try to negotiate lower. If partner insists, request refundable hold in the agreement and milestone tie-outs. If still > $20k, loop exec sponsor.
Leo (Eng): For vendor onboarding lead time, what's realistic if Legal needs to review the prepay clause?
Olivia (Finance Ops): Typical timeline: 5-8 business days if contract straightforward; add 3-5 days for bespoke refund language. Use the expedited tag if needed.
Priya K (FP&A): Reminder: we want to preserve a 12-month runway buffer. If a payment would push your cost center projection below that, expect stricter scrutiny.
budget-bot: FYI: monthly cash burn snapshot posted to the all-hands doc.
Maya (Partnerships): Got it, will try 10% and file ticket with the partner term sheet. Thanks.
Aisha (CFO): Thanks team 60 follow-up: Priya will publish a short checklist for prepay requests and approvals by EOD tomorrow.
Priya K (FP&A): Will do 60 checklist will include who signs, modelling note, and expedited routing instructions.
Olivia (Finance Ops): Action: Partnerships file ticket; mark PREPAY and attach term sheet. Finance Ops will ack within 24 hours.
